g.text: Supply: -A1.3 groups 1L+ (ch. 0...7) and 2L+ (ch. 8...15) and -A1.4 group A (ch. 0...3) from 24V-S /E-06.7; -A1.4 group B (ch. 4...7) from +24.3 /E-01.4, so amber and red stay lit on an E-stop.
Outputs are high-side, short-circuit proof, 0.5 A. Solenoids with DIN 43650 plugs including suppressor diodes; contactor coils with plug-in suppressor modules.
Irrigation, fertigation and climate control, 1 000 m² greenhouse
OpenPLC Runtime v4 + Modbus TCP remote I/O
Electrical drawing set - control panel GH-1 (pump room)
